## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1 — broad sector participation (8/11) supports no clear directional bias; Confirmation 2 — leadership is highly concentrated in Healthcare while Technology is broadly BELOW TREND, signaling mixed internals and a transitional market.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Healthcare leads: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND. Real Estate strong: WELL (1W: +10.01% | 1M: +6.14%) ABOVE TREND, VTR (1W: +9.13% | 1M: +1.14%) ABOVE TREND. Utilities showing resilience at sector level (1W: +3.09% | 1M: +2.28% — 10 stocks).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -9.62%) BELOW TREND; Tech 1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.62% (24 stocks). Materials weak: DOW (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -14.95%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -1.85%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Discretionary soft: NKE (1W: -9.85% | 1M: -10.58%) BELOW TREND, TSLA (1W: -5.19% | 1M: -13.77%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +10.97% | 1M: +13.55%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +10.42% | 1M: +12.57%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Healthcare).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: DOW (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -14.95%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -9.07% | 1M: -1.85%) BELOW TREND, NKE (1W: -9.85% | 1M: -10.58%) BELOW TREND, CME (1W: -10.30% | 1M: -20.41%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in Technology and Materials with notable Financial carve-out hits.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Highest 1W momentum in Healthcare: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, MRK (1W: +12.99% | 1M: +7.77%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND; on the downside NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND and ORCL (1W: -19.40% | 1M: -22.22%) BELOW TREND show heavy weekly momentum to the downside. No MAJOR divergence pattern (fewer than three giants flipping sign vs. 1M), so momentum appears stock-specific.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Sector tone: negative and mixed internally; NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -9.62%) BELOW TREND while IBM (1W: +9.04% | 1M: +6.44%) ABOVE TREND is an outlier — Technology 1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.62% (24 stocks).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are stable-to-positive: JPM (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +2.75% | 1M: +2.63%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.88% | 1M: +0.80%) ABOVE TREND — Financials 1W: +0.09% | 1M: +4.33% (20 stocks) showing incremental strength.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare leading and broad: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +9.97% | 1M: +11.56%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +6.72% | 1M: +12.06%) ABOVE TREND — Healthcare 1W: +7.10% | 1M: +7.05% (17 stocks), clear sector rotation into defensives/health catalysts.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor exposure to Healthcare leaders (ABBV, JNJ, MRK) and select Financials (JPM, V, MA) given mixed but positive breadth; reduce exposure to broad Technology names showing BELOW TREND (NVDA, AAPL, MSFT). Style: mixed / no clear leadership due to Healthcare concentration and Tech weakness — be selective and monitor liquidity in narrow leadership names.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -19.40% | 1M: -22.22%) BELOW TREND, QCOM (1W: -16.24% | 1M: -18.56%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**

BEARISH: Technology (1W: -3.49% | 1M: -3.62% — 24 stocks), Materials (1W: -1.12% | 1M: +0.02% — 11 stocks).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND — watch for a weekly close that stabilizes above the recent swing low to signal base building.  
AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND — monitor for a short-term recovery above -2% weekly to reduce downside risk.  
JPM (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +9.95%) ABOVE TREND — sustained weekly strength would confirm Financials’ rotation; failure to hold recent gains would warn of reversion.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

MSFT (-45): Microsoft (1W: -1.69% | 1M: -9.62%) BELOW TREND — downgrade and price weakness aligned.  
AAPL (-45): Apple (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND — sentiment concerns matching recent underperformance.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. ABBV (1W: +17.03% | 1M: +17.62%) ABOVE TREND and JNJ (1W: +11.50% | 1M: +10.10%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength while NVDA (1W: -8.62% | 1M: -9.33%) BELOW TREND and AAPL (1W: -4.78% | 1M: -8.71%) BELOW TREND show notable weakness. Key risk: narrow Healthcare leadership and Tech price/sentiment divergence — monitor headline-driven moves (GILD/MA/TSLA) for confirmation before broadening exposure.
